mapper.sql: id, nombre, descripcion, icono, url, orden, menu_id, activo, created_at, updated_at, deleted, version
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO (nombre, descripcion, icono, url, orden, menu_id, activo) VALUES (#{nombre}, #{descripcion}, #{icono}, #{url}, #{orden}, #{menuId}, #{activo})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = FALSE
SELECT FROM WHERE menu_id = #{menuId} AND deleted = FALSE ORDER BY orden ASC

SELECT DISTINCT sm.id, sm.nombre, sm.descripcion, sm.icono, sm.url, sm.orden, sm.menu_id, sm.activo, sm.created_at, sm.updated_at, sm.deleted, sm.version FROM submenu sm INNER JOIN permiso p ON p.submenu_id = sm.id AND p.deleted = FALSE AND p.leer = TRUE INNER JOIN usuario_rol ur ON ur.rol_id = p.rol_id AND ur.deleted = FALSE INNER JOIN usuario u ON u.id = ur.usuario_id AND u.deleted = FALSE WHERE sm.menu_id = #{menuId} AND sm.deleted = FALSE AND sm.activo = TRUE AND u.username = #{username} ORDER BY sm.orden ASC
SELECT FROM WHERE deleted = FALSE ORDER BY orden ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE SET nombre = #{nombre}, descripcion = #{descripcion}, icono = #{icono}, url = #{url}, orden = #{orden}, menu_id = #{menuId}, activo = #{activo}, updated_at = NOW(), version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = FALSE
UPDATE SET deleted = TRUE, updated_at = NOW(), version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
